subject.title: fix: preserve discovered context limits over static metadata

question: Should provider-discovered account-specific context limits permanently outrank matching manifest/config-overlaid and bundled static catalog limits across the prepared model-catalog lifecycle?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically coherent, but the durable cross-provider authority rule affects existing authenticated sessions, context compaction, and catalog compatibility; that policy cannot be inferred safely from tests alone.

options.title: Approve discovered-limit authority
options.body: Accept provider-discovered context limits as authoritative for matching discovered provider/model identities while retaining explicit configured-context overrides and static fallback for undiscovered models.

options.title: Keep overlay authority
options.body: Require a revised design in which manifest or configured catalog overlays may continue to replace discovered limits, with a narrower fix for the original Copilot symptom.

options.title: Pause for a broader catalog contract
options.body: Defer this PR until owners document one precedence matrix for discovery, configured overrides, aliases, and static metadata.

recommendation.title: Approve discovered-limit authority
recommendation.body: Accept provider-discovered context limits as authoritative for matching discovered provider/model identities while retaining explicit configured-context overrides and static fallback for undiscovered models.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the lifecycle-owned prepared model catalog that defines the ownership boundary this PR changes.
